none: PAS CAM-E8FEE8: Roman Coin : A silver clipped Siliqua of Valentinian I, AD364-375
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ RESTITVTOR REIP ; D/ D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG

A silver clipped Siliqua of Valentinian I, AD364-375. AD364-367 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads RESTITVTOR REIP. Reverse shows Emperor standing holding labarum and Victory on globe. Mint is Lyon. See RIC IX, p.43, no.6d. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG. Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 1.8g,…
